events.title: Bàn giao nông trại
events.body: Grandpa để lại nông trại cho bạn. Robin dẫn bạn từ trạm xe tới nhà, nơi thị trưởng Lewis đang chờ.

events.title: Lời mời của Willy
events.body: Hello there,^Just got back from a fishing trip. You should come down to the beach some time.^I've got something for ya.^-Willy

events.title: Cần câu đầu tiên
events.body: Đọc thư của Willy rồi đến bãi biển trước 17:10 để gặp bác ở cầu tàu.

events.title: Mưa đầu mùa
events.body: Mưa cả ngày. Dân làng dùng lịch ngày mưa nếu có.

events.title: Mở khu mỏ phía Bắc
events.body: Lối vào mỏ trên núi đã thông.

events.title: Joja đã dọn đá lở
events.body: To our valued JojaMart customers:^Our team members have removed the landslide caused by our drilling operation near the mountain lake. I'd like to remind you that our drilling operation is entirely legal (pursuant to init. L61091, JojaCo Amendment). Responsible stewardship of the local environment is our top priority! ^^We apologize for any inconvenience this accident may have caused.^As always, we value your continued support and patronage!^^-Morris,^Joja Customer Satisfaction Representative

events.title: Thanh kiếm của Marlon
events.body: Marlon trao thanh kiếm gỉ để bạn tự vệ trong mỏ.

events.title: Trung tâm cộng đồng
events.body: Ra Town vào buổi sáng trời quang: Lewis dẫn bạn vào Nhà văn hóa cũ, nơi các Junimo đang nhảy múa.

events.title: Cuộn giấy Junimo
events.body: Bạn tìm thấy chữ viết lạ trong phòng thủ công.

events.title: Thư của Pháp sư
events.body: My sources tell me you've been poking around inside the old community center.^Why don't you pay me a visit?^My chambers are west of the forest lake, in the stone tower. I may have information concerning your... 'rat problem'.^   -M. Rasmodius, Wizard

events.title: Học tiếng Junimo
events.body: M. Rasmodius mời bạn uống thuốc từ chiếc vạc. Giờ bạn đã hiểu chữ viết của Junimo.

events.title: Rìu thất lạc của Robin
events.body: MISSING:^I lost my favorite Axe! If you find it, please return ASAP. I'm having a tough time without it. There's 250g in it for whoever finds the thing.^   -Robin
events.success: Hey, you found my axe! What a relief... I almost chopped my toe off with the other one I was using. Thank you!

events.title: Thư mời Lễ hội Trứng
events.body: Dear @,^Tomorrow we're holding the Egg Festival in the town square. ^^You should arrive between 9 AM and 2 PM if you'd like to attend.^You wouldn't want to miss the annual egg hunt!^  -Mayor Lewis

events.title: Lễ hội Trứng
events.body: Lewis khai mạc cuộc săn trứng. Pierre trông quầy hàng.

events.title: Mùa dâu dại
events.body: Hái Salmonberry ở bụi cây trong các ngày 15–18 mùa xuân.

events.title: Lời nhắc đổi mùa của Evelyn
events.body: Hello, dear...^^I know you're just getting started as a gardener, so I wanted to give you a little tip.^^Most crops only grow in one season. When summer arrives, your spring crops will all die out. So plan ahead!^^-Granny Evelyn

events.title: Jodi cần súp lơ
events.body: Farmer @-^I have a request for you. I need fresh cauliflower for a recipe I want to make. Could you bring me one?^   -Jodi
events.success: Oh, that looks so delicious! Thank you, this is just what I wanted. It's going to be perfect for my yellow curry.

events.title: Thư mời Vũ hội Hoa
events.body: Dear @,^Tomorrow we're all getting together for the Flower Dance.^^If you can find a partner, you might even want to participate in the dance yourself!^There's a little clearing beyond the forest west of town where we hold the dance. Arrive between 9 AM and 2 PM if you're interested.^  -Mayor Lewis

events.title: Vũ hội Hoa
events.body: Mời một bạn nhảy khi tình bạn đạt 4 tim.

events.title: Bắt đầu mùa hè
events.body: Dân làng chuyển sang lịch mùa hè.

events.title: Động đất mở đường lên Spa
events.body: Động đất làm đá chắn đường vỡ ra. Đường lên Railroad và Spa đã mở.

events.title: Quần đùi của thị trưởng
events.body: @-^This is embarrassing... I lost my lucky purple shorts. I'm telling you because I think I can trust you.^If you find them, bring them back to me DISCREETLY. I'll pay well.^Thanks.^   -Mayor Lewis
events.objective: Find and return Mayor Lewis' purple shorts.

events.title: Thư mời Luau
events.body: Dear @,^Tomorrow we're all gathering at the beach for the annual Pelican Town Luau.^^The highlight of the event is the communal potluck. Make sure you bring something good to contribute!^The governor himself is attending the event, so make sure you're on your best behavior.^Come to the beach sometime between 9 AM and 2 PM.^   -Mayor Lewis

events.title: Luau
events.body: Góp một món ăn vào nồi súp để Thống đốc nếm thử.

events.title: Pam muốn Pale Ale
events.body: Hey Kid,^My throat's about as dry as a desert bone. I'm real thirsty for a pale ale. You got one? Regular old beer won't do. I need a pale ale.^   -Pam
events.success: Gimme that. *slurp*... Ahh, that's the stuff.

events.title: Dưa lưới cho nghiên cứu
events.body: @-^I'm gathering data on the correlation between soil alkalinity and crop fructose levels. Long story short, I need a fresh melon from your farm. If you brought me one I'd be very grateful.^   -Demetrius
events.success: This is perfect! It's just what I need for my research. It's going to be hard not to eat it! Thanks a bunch.

events.title: Ớt cay cho George
events.body: To Farmer @:^My knee's acting up again, and you know what helps? ^Rubbing the darn thing with hot pepper.^ Trouble is, my supply's run dry. If you've got one to spare I'd be much obliged.^   -George
events.success: Took you long enough... hmmph... Well it's good and spicy at least. Thanks.

events.title: Thư nhắc ngắm sứa
events.body: Dear @,^Tonight at around 10 o'clock PM, a rare and beautiful event will take place.^^The moonlight jellies will be passing by Pelican Town on their long journey south for the winter.^^We're all gathering at the beach to watch. You don't want to miss this!^See you tonight,^ -Demetrius

events.title: Đêm Sứa Ánh Trăng
events.body: Lewis thả thuyền nến dẫn đường cho đàn sứa phát sáng.

events.title: Rau dền cho đàn bò
events.body: Dear @,^I'd like to give my cows a special treat. They're such good girls and hungry, too. Could you bring me one bunch of amaranth? They love the stuff. ^Thanks, Dear.^   -Marnie
events.objective: Bring Marnie one bunch of amaranth.
events.success: Oh, the amaranth I asked for! Thank you so much... my cows are going to love this!

events.title: Giỏ mâm xôi thất lạc
events.body: Hello,^It's blackberry season right now. The bushes are full of them. I want to pick some, but I lost my basket. Can you help?^   -Linus
events.objective: Find Linus' basket and return it to him.
events.success: My basket! Thank you. This means a lot to me.

events.title: Mùa mâm xôi đen
events.body: Hái Blackberry ở bụi cây trong các ngày 8–11 mùa thu.

events.title: Thư nhắc mang 9 món đi thi
events.body: Dear @,^I just want to remind you that the Stardew Valley Fair is happening tomorrow.^Don't forget to bring your 9 items for the grange display.^Remember, the fair starts at 9AM in the town square. See you there!^   -Mayor Lewis

events.title: Hội chợ Thung lũng
events.body: Lewis chấm gian hàng. Pierre mang sản vật của mình đến dự.

events.title: Bí ngô làm lồng đèn
events.body: @-^I'd like to buy a pumpkin from you. My daughter and I want to carve a jack-o-lantern for the upcoming Spirit's Eve festival. ^   -Caroline
events.success: Oh, the pumpkin! It's a good one... Abigail will be so happy when she sees this. Thanks, @!

events.title: Thư mời Đêm Ma Quái
events.body: Dear @,^Notice a chill in the air? It could just be the approach of winter...^Or it could be the tingle of a dark specter, here to help us celebrate tomorrow's festival... the Spirit's Eve.^Come to town at 10 PM if you'd like to participate.^  -Mayor Lewis

events.title: Đêm Ma Quái
events.body: Khám phá mê cung của Wizard và tìm phần thưởng cuối đường.

events.title: Bóng đen bỏ chạy
events.body: Một bóng đen giống Krobus chạy về phía thị trấn. Lần theo dấu chân đến bụi cây ở Town.

events.title: Kính lúp
events.body: Bóng đen bước ra khỏi bụi cây và để lại Kính Lúp.

events.title: Thách thức câu mực
events.body: Hey, I've got a little challenge for you:^    Catch me a squid.^You can fish them from the ocean at night. They only show up in the winter, though.^   -Willy
events.success: Hey, you did it! Not bad. Not bad at all. I'm impressed.

events.title: Tặng Amethyst cho Emily
events.body: I've got an unusual request. Could you keep this a secret?^ I want you to deliver an amethyst to Emily. It's her favorite stone. Tell her it's from me.^   -Clint
events.success: Oh, my favorite stone! You're so sweet!

events.title: Lễ hội Băng Tuyết
events.body: Willy, Pam và Elliott thi câu cá xuyên băng. Leah tạc tượng băng.

events.title: Nguyên liệu ma thuật đen
events.body: @-^I am researching the forgotten art of shadow divination. I require an item known as 'Void Essence'. Bring it to me and you will be rewarded.^ -M. Rasmodius, Wizard
events.success: Ah, you've brought it. You've earned my gratitude, and a 1000g reward. Now go.

events.title: Chợ Đêm
events.body: Ghé tàu ngầm, nghe nàng tiên cá hát, uống cà phê hoặc xem tranh.

events.title: Clint thử búa mới
events.body: @,^Sorry to bother you again, but I need another favor.^I got a new hammer and I want to try it on a variety of metals.^Could you smelt an iron bar and bring it to me? ^Thanks.^ -Clint
events.success: Hey, it's the iron bar I asked for. It looks strong... perfect.

events.title: Người bạn bí mật
events.body: Dear @,^I would like to give you some information about an upcoming event: the Feast of the Winter Star. It's a time for the community to come together and think back on all the good fortune we've had this year.^A favorite tradition is the "secret gift exchange", where everyone in town is randomly assigned to someone else. On the day of the festival, everyone brings a gift for their secret friend and surprises them with something special!^This year, your secret friend is:^    %secretsanta ^Don't tell anyone! The feast will take place on the 25th from 9AM to 2PM at the town square. See you then! ^   -Mayor Lewis

events.title: Gỗ cứng sửa nhà
events.body: @-^How are you doing? Hope the winter hasn't been too hard on you.^Anyway, I'm writing to ask you for some hardwood. I need about ten pieces, if you've got it.^If not, no worries. Take Care!^  -Robin
events.success: Oh, you brought it! I know I can always count on you, @.

events.title: Lễ hội Ngôi Sao Mùa Đông
events.body: Mang quà cho người bạn bí mật. Người tặng quà xuất hiện sau khi bạn trao quà.

events.title: Cá ngừ cho món súp
events.body: Dear @-^I want to make fish stew, but I need an albacore! I know they're almost out of season... sorry about the short notice. Could you catch one for me?^   -Gus
events.success: *sniff*...*sniff*... What's that? Something smells like albacore!
